description: Organizations, memberships, invitation acceptance and the no-organization page

organizations.created.description: An organization was created with its owner

organizations.member-added.description: A user became a member of the organization

organizations.member-removed.description: A member was removed from the organization or left it

organizations.member-role-changed.description: The organization role of a member changed

/organization/create.description: better-auth creates an organization; emits organizations.created

/organization/invite-member.description: better-auth invites a member by email; emits users.invited

/organization/cancel-invitation.description: better-auth cancels an invitation; emits users.invitation-canceled

/organization/accept-invitation.description: better-auth accepts an invitation; emits users.invitation-accepted and organizations.member-added

/organization/update-member-role.description: better-auth changes a member role; emits organizations.member-role-changed

/organization/remove-member.description: better-auth removes a member; emits organizations.member-removed

/organization/leave.description: better-auth lets a member leave the organization; emits organizations.member-removed
